title: Madison Donut Boat Company
specs: Electric boats with quiet motors and intuitive steering, max speed 5-6 mph
Must be 21+ to rent and operate the boat
Operator must have boating license: born before 1/1/1989 need valid driver's license; born after must complete Wisconsin boating safety exam
Operator must provide proof of license before boarding
Children under 13 must wear life jackets while underway
Each boat seats up to 10 passengers with a total weight limit; can book multiple boats
includes: Life jackets for children and adults
Safety briefing and tutorial before departure
blurb: Guests rent electric donut boats that seat up to 10 people and cruise at about 5 mph on Lake Waubesa. Rentals include a shaded canopy and a center table for snacks and drinks. Guests captain the boats themselves after a safety briefing and must be 21+ to operate with required boating licenses.
extraNote: Full refund if canceled at least 72 hours before rental (Stripe fees apply) · Boats operate rain or shine except in dangerous conditions (lightning, thunderstorms, high winds) · If weather unsafe, booking will be rescheduled · Dock slip at 2952 Waubesa Avenue Madison, WI 53711 (Christy’s Landing)
